$comment: Documentation-only schema for assets/config/family_activities.json. Not enforced by a JSON-schema validator at build time — lib/models/family_activity.dart's FamilyActivity.fromJson performs the equivalent fail-fast validation at load time, and test/family_activity_schema_test.dart asserts every activity in the bundled asset satisfies it (including per-locale text completeness for the 5 production locales).

activities.id: string, must match ^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)+$, stable and never reused
activities.category: one of: numberSense, addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, fractions, decimals, ratio, percentages, geometry, measurement, algebra, patterns, logic, mentalMaths, spatialReasoning
activities.maxMinutes: integer <= 10, >= minMinutes — every activity must stay within a 5-10 minute window
activities.contentVersion: integer >= 1, bump whenever this activity's text changes
activities.studioConnectionRouteSuffix: string or null, relative to /math-studio/ (e.g. 'discovery/cooking-fraction-conversion', 'mental-maths') — optional link back into an existing pillar/card, never a new nav destination
activities.visual: object or omitted — { animationId: string }, a reference into assets/manim_static/manifest.json's own animationId (a separate pipeline, see docs/MANIM_PIPELINE_SPEC.md); duration/asset-path/review-status live only in that manifest, never duplicated here. No manifest-loading service or UI reads this yet — Phase 2 shipped it as inert data on exactly two candidate activities (ratio-recipes, cube-views) ahead of a future visual-support pass.

<bcp47 tag, e.g. en / en-GB / de-CH / fr.title: string
<bcp47 tag, e.g. en / en-GB / de-CH / fr.materialsNeeded: array of 1+ strings, everyday household items only
<bcp47 tag, e.g. en / en-GB / de-CH / fr.whatYourChildLearns: string, the underlying concept in plain language
<bcp47 tag, e.g. en / en-GB / de-CH / fr.letsExplore: string, what to do together — no worksheet, no right/wrong framing
<bcp47 tag, e.g. en / en-GB / de-CH / fr.questionsToAsk: array of 2-4 strings, open questions a parent can ask without needing the answer themselves
<bcp47 tag, e.g. en / en-GB / de-CH / fr.commonMisconceptions: string, what's developmentally normal to see and why
<bcp47 tag, e.g. en / en-GB / de-CH / fr.tryTomorrow: string, a tiny follow-up that needs no preparation
<bcp47 tag, e.g. en / en-GB / de-CH / fr.captainMathPrompt: string, Captain Math speaking directly to the child — concrete and inviting
<bcp47 tag, e.g. en / en-GB / de-CH / fr.alliePrompt: string, Allie speaking to the parent — reassurance/light guidance, never an instruction to 'teach'; always static authored copy, never implies a live/conversational feature
<bcp47 tag, e.g. en / en-GB / de-CH / fr.studioConnectionNote: string, required only when the activity's studioConnectionRouteSuffix is set; must be omitted otherwise
